achievements.title: First Spark
achievements.lore: Every planeswalker remembers the first time the spark caught.

achievements.title: Faithful Planeswalker
achievements.lore: Days you came back to the Multiverse. Missed days never reset it.

achievements.riddle: One breath stands between you and the grave.

achievements.title: Toll Unpaid
achievements.lore: Cross the Goblin King's pass by turn 8. He never saw the sky coming.

achievements.title: Fair Winds
achievements.lore: Reach Serendib before its Efreet ever takes the field.

achievements.riddle: Someone else was listening. Win every battle of Act 1 with its own decks, then answer them.

achievements.title: Unbroken
achievements.lore: Beat Mishra without your life ever dropping below 10. The brothers were never this even.

achievements.title: Faster Than The Deck
achievements.lore: Beat Arcades Sabboth's control deck by turn 12, before it takes over.

achievements.title: Second Breath
achievements.lore: Beat Nicol Bolas on the draw. Elder Dragons hate going first.

achievements.title: Before the Shade
achievements.lore: Win Necro Summer before Ihsan's Shade ever rises.

achievements.title: Warm Blood
achievements.lore: Beat Lim-Dûl with 15 life or more. The dead never touched you.

achievements.title: Ride Beside Me
achievements.lore: Have four creatures on the field at once in Jabari's charge.

achievements.title: No Sale
achievements.lore: Beat Pashad by turn 10. Keep your goats.

achievements.title: The Reeds Hold
achievements.lore: Beat Kaervek on the draw.

achievements.title: Kinfolk
achievements.lore: Have five slivers on the field at once.

achievements.title: Dreamless
achievements.lore: Win the Laboratory before Recurring Nightmare ever hits the table.

achievements.title: For Mirri
achievements.lore: Beat Volrath with Mirri fighting at your side.

achievements.title: Mi'uto
achievements.lore: Take the Thran mana rig from the goblins of Shiv by turn 9.

achievements.title: The School Stands
achievements.lore: Beat Gix with 15 life or more. Not one child lost.

achievements.title: General Nuisance
achievements.lore: As Squee, have five creatures on the field at once. They gave him a hat for a reason.

achievements.title: Unmasked
achievements.lore: Beat Takara before Volrath ever shows his true shape.

achievements.title: Defiant
achievements.lore: Beat the Ascendant Evincar with Lin Sivvi on the field.

achievements.title: Gaea Insisted

achievements.title: Ain't Thirsty
achievements.lore: Beat Lord Dralnu before his Lord of the Undead ever reaches the table.

achievements.title: This Is My Destiny
achievements.lore: Beat Yawgmoth with Gerrard Capashen on the field.

achievements.title: Thirteen
achievements.lore: Win the pit fight by turn 8. The house never saw it coming.

achievements.title: Keep an Eye Out
achievements.lore: Have six creatures on the field at once in Krosa. The squirrels are watching.

achievements.title: Penance
